name: Parent IDs Fixer
teaser: Fixes stupid BSG incorrect parent IDs
description_html:
Regarding SPT 3.9.X or higher
If you’re a user:
I do not plan on actively playing SPT 3.9.X or higher, therefore I do not plan on updating my less-used mods.

If you’re a modder:
Do not reupload my old mods, thank you. If you want to fix compatibility, please ping MusicManiac on SPT discord and I can add you to authors so you can update the mod if it requires an update.

Fixes _parent value of some guns and items.
for example, _parent of AG 545 is assault rifle instead of assault carbine

This fixes internal inconsistencies in BSG database.

check mod.ts if you wanna see full list of parent ids that got fixed
